prompt: I think this is (calm) airport I have ever walked through.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «the + превосходная степень + Present Perfect + ever» описывает самый яркий опыт за всё время. Односложное прилагательное calm образует превосходную степень с помощью -est.

prompt: Why does our island airport have (few) seats and (little) food when strong winds stop the flights?
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (seats) используется превосходная степень the fewest, а с неисчисляемым (food) — the least.

prompt: Look at my granddaughter running out with (happy) smile in the whole airport!
explanation_ru: Сравнение идёт со всеми людьми в аэропорту (in the whole airport), поэтому нужна превосходная степень с артиклем the; конечная -y после согласной меняется на -i.

prompt: Is this ground-floor room ___ in the whole lodge?
explanation_ru: При сравнении среди всех комнат отеля (in the whole lodge) нужна превосходная степень с артиклем the. Типичная ошибка — опускать the или смешивать most и -est.

prompt: Dear Paul, I visited five sailing schools in La Rochelle for the kids. Blue Bay is one of (safe / school) in the area because they keep small boats near the shore. Their teachers explain the rules (clearly) of all the groups I met. The harbour club was cheaper, but it offered (few) morning breaks of the five.
explanation_ru: После one of the всегда ставится превосходная степень и существительное во множественном числе (the safest schools). Наречие на -ly (clearly) образует превосходную степень с most, а с исчисляемым breaks используется the fewest.

prompt: This narrow street has one of the worst bus stop in town.
answer: This narrow street has one of the worst bus stops in town.
accepted_answers: This narrow street has one of the worst bus stops in town.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить существительное в единственном числе после one of the + превосходная степень. Нужно множественное число: one of the worst bus stops.

prompt: Out of four small hire cars in Livorno, the blue model drove (smoothly) and held my heavy bags (well).
explanation_ru: Сравниваются четыре машины (out of four), поэтому нужны превосходные степени наречий: smoothly → (the) most smoothly, а неправильное наречие well → (the) best.

prompt: Sunday mornings are (busy) time of the week in this ferry car park.
explanation_ru: Выражение of the week задаёт сравнение среди всех дней недели, поэтому нужна превосходная степень the busiest (y → i перед -est).

prompt: Oscar says the downstairs court isn't the newest, yet it is ___ place in our club to play after work.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения наименьшей степени признака среди всех объектов используется the least + прилагательное. Типичная ошибка — путать сравнительную форму less с превосходной least или опускать артикль the.

prompt: Although our cricket club uses six fields across Wrexham, the changing room by the river has (bad) drains I have ever seen in a public building.
explanation_ru: В сочетании с Present Perfect и ever требуется превосходная степень, а прилагательное bad имеет неправильную форму the worst.

prompt: Landon looked up at six bright walls in the climbing gym. "Which wall is (easy) for a new climber?" he asked. His guide pointed to the blue side. "Start there, because beginners climb (safely) on those wide steps," she smiled.
explanation_ru: Выбор делается из шести стен, поэтому нужны превосходные степени: прилагательное easy → the easiest и наречие safely → (the) most safely.

prompt: This autumn gave our lake club the less sunshine we have recorded in ten years.
answer: This autumn gave our lake club the least sunshine we have recorded in ten years.
accepted_answers: This autumn gave our lake club the least sunshine we have recorded in ten years.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать сравнительную форму less вместо превосходной least в конструкции с Present Perfect. Правильно: the least sunshine.

prompt: Benedikt bought a cheap high seat in the Bayreuth hall, and the sound was clearer there than anywhere else.
options: He sat in the most expensive seat, so he could not hear the music as clearly as others.
He sat in the cheapest seat, which had the worst sound of every row in the hall.
He sat in one of the priciest rows, where a wooden post blocked the stage the least.
He sat in one of the cheapest seats, yet he heard the music the most clearly in the hall.
explanation_ru: Только четвёртый вариант точно передаёт оба факта: недорогое место (one of the cheapest seats) и лучший звук во всём зале (the most clearly in the hall).

prompt: Clint tried five small guitars and picked the one that rang (brightly).
explanation_ru: Выбирается один инструмент из пяти, поэтому наречие brightly ставится в превосходную степень с most.

prompt: Sorry for sharing pages today—this is (small) number of concert programmes our park band has ever received from the printer.
explanation_ru: Сочетание с Present Perfect и ever указывает на рекордный случай за всё время, поэтому требуется превосходная степень the smallest.

prompt: My nieces loved the morning puppet play—it was ___ show they have ever seen.
explanation_ru: С ever и Present Perfect употребляется превосходная степень с артиклем the. Типичная ошибка — добавлять most к форме на -est или опускать the.

prompt: Raluca lined up seven cloth foxes and asked, "Which puppet jumps (high) on stage?"
explanation_ru: Из семи кукол выбирается рекордсмен по высоте прыжка, а короткое наречие high образует превосходную степень с помощью -est.

prompt: I have never walked through such a peaceful museum room before. → This is …
answer: This is the most peaceful museum room I have ever walked through.
accepted_answers: This is the most peaceful museum room I have ever walked through.
This is the most peaceful museum room I've ever walked through.
This is the most peaceful museum room that I have ever walked through.
This is the most peaceful museum room that I've ever walked through.
explanation_ru: Фраза «never … such a peaceful …» перефразируется через превосходную степень с Present Perfect и ever: the most peaceful museum room I have ever walked through.

prompt: Humphrey spread six handmade farm blankets across the museum table in Carlisle. The red one from 1890 is (second / old) piece in the whole collection, yet its colours have faded (little) over the years. Even though visitors rarely stop at the entrance, Humphrey hopes this bright blanket will attract (many) guests of all the winter displays. Nobody in the storeroom remembered seeing a warmer pattern.
explanation_ru: Порядковое числительное с превосходной степенью образует форму the second-oldest; наречие little в значении «меньше всего» даёт (the) least, а many перед исчисляемым guests — the most.

prompt: Didn't Elodie build one of (clever / project) in the whole science fair?
explanation_ru: В конструкции one of the + превосходная степень существительное всегда стоит во множественном числе (projects); двусложное clever допускает формы cleverest и most clever.

prompt: Even though our hillside is still (third / dark) spot in the region, those bright car-park lamps ruin the sky more than anything else in town.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения места в рейтинге используется модель the + порядковое числительное + превосходная степень: the third-darkest.

prompt: Fabrice watched the children test six light wooden bridges with small bags of rice. "Which bridge held the weight (long)?" a girl called out. Everyone cheered when the narrow triangle stayed up after all the others fell. It wasn't the biggest model, yet it carried (heavy) load of all six designs and bent (slowly) under pressure.
explanation_ru: Из шести мостов выбирается лучший по разным параметрам: короткое наречие long → (the) longest, прилагательное heavy → the heaviest, наречие на -ly slowly → (the) most slowly.

prompt: Because heavier glasses always slide down his nose while he plays the violin, Detlef tried eight slim frames in Flensburg until he found (light) pair in the shop.
explanation_ru: Выбор делается из всех оправ в магазине (in the shop), поэтому односложное прилагательное light используется в превосходной степени the lightest.

prompt: Kelvin says the afternoon nurse is the kindest person ___ the whole health centre in Truro.
explanation_ru: После превосходной степени с названиями мест и организаций (the whole health centre) употребляется предлог in, а не of или from — это частая ошибка под влиянием русского языка.

prompt: Does warming up for five minutes really help you swim (fast) in cold evening air?
explanation_ru: Короткое наречие fast не получает суффикс -ly и в превосходной степени имеет форму (the) fastest.

prompt: I repair phones in Kochi, and this heavy software update is (bad) release I have ever installed. Older models that used to run smoothly can barely send a text now. Even one of (reliable / handset) in our shop froze twice during testing. Nobody understands why a simple update uses (much) memory of all the versions this year.
explanation_ru: С ever используется неправильная превосходная степень the worst; после one of the нужно множественное число handsets; перед неисчисляемым memory превосходная степень от much — the most.

prompt: Emil decided that the heavy metal stand held his camera the most steadily of all the tools on his desk.
answer: Emil decided that the heavy metal stand held his camera the most steadily of all the tools on his desk.
accepted_answers: Emil decided that the heavy metal stand held his camera the most steadily of all the tools on his desk.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: наречие steadily верно стоит в превосходной степени the most steadily, а предлог of корректно вводит группу объектов (of all the tools).

prompt: After switching off my phone alerts, I solved this week's coding task (quickly) in my whole study group.
explanation_ru: Сравнение идёт со всей учебной группой (in my whole study group), поэтому наречие quickly требует превосходной степени (the) most quickly.

prompt: Margaux picked up five pocket chargers at the counter in Perpignan. "This slim grey one is (thin) in the box," the clerk said. Margaux slid it next to her bus pass with a smile. "Great, and it isn't (expensive) one either!"
explanation_ru: При выборе из пяти устройств используются превосходные степени: в коротком thin удваивается согласная (the thinnest), а длинное expensive образует форму с the most.

prompt: Patricio tried four bike-map apps in Cuenca. The free one showed every hill shortcut and never got him lost.
options: The free app was the least helpful one on his phone.
The free app worked the best of all the maps he tried.
The paid map was the only app that showed hill shortcuts.
Patricio found that the free app was the most expensive choice.
explanation_ru: Бесплатное приложение оказалось самым удачным из четырёх, что точно передаёт превосходная степень наречия well — worked the best of all.

prompt: Because unlocked front gates make quick theft simple, Officer Trent's flyer warns that leaving shiny tools by the road is ___ mistakes homeowners can make.
explanation_ru: Правильный каркас конструкции — one of the + превосходная степень + множественное число. Типичная ошибка — опускать артикль the или ставить сравнительную степень more вместо most.

prompt: Alasdair checked three tours at Ludlow Castle before his uncle arrived. "The courtyard audio walk is (cheap) option on the list," the ticket clerk explained. "However, visitors say the old bakery talk is one of (lively / tour) in the region, and it ends (early) of the three." Alasdair bought two tickets for the bakery right away.
explanation_ru: Из трёх экскурсий выделяются крайние признаки: односложное cheap → the cheapest, после one of the ставится множественное число (the liveliest tours), а наречие early → (the) earliest.

prompt: Down in the stone cellar in Winchester, Agnes laid six heavy bell parts along a wool blanket. The worn iron bar on the left belonged to (old) bell in the cathedral tower, which hasn't rung for forty years. Surprisingly, the curved ring on the right fitted (closely) of all six pieces. Agnes smiled because she had finally solved one of (strange / puzzle) in the cellar.
explanation_ru: Для предмета (bell) используется the oldest (а не eldest); наречие closely образует форму (the) most closely; после one of the требуется существительное во множественном числе (the strangest puzzles).

prompt: Once Kerstin held five pale tiles beside the sink, she knew creamy white would make the attic the brightest room of the whole house.
answer: Once Kerstin held five pale tiles beside the sink, she knew creamy white would make the attic the brightest room in the whole house.
accepted_answers: Once Kerstin held five pale tiles beside the sink, she knew creamy white would make the attic the brightest room in the whole house.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить of перед названием места или пространства (the whole house). С местами после превосходной степени нужен предлог in.

prompt: We have never stayed in a cosier wooden flat during a snowy winter than Ryota's place in Aomori. → Ryota's place in Aomori is …
answer: Ryota's place in Aomori is the cosiest wooden flat we have ever stayed in during a snowy winter.
accepted_answers: Ryota's place in Aomori is the cosiest wooden flat we have ever stayed in during a snowy winter.
Ryota's place in Aomori is the cosiest wooden flat we've ever stayed in during a snowy winter.
Ryota's place in Aomori is the cosiest wooden flat that we have ever stayed in during a snowy winter.
Ryota's place in Aomori is the cosiest wooden flat that we've ever stayed in during a snowy winter.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное сравнение с never перестраивается в превосходную степень с Present Perfect и ever: the cosiest wooden flat we have ever stayed in.
